def evolved_p91(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # Formula: x[i,j] = (-1)^(i+j) -> +1 even parity, -1 odd parity.
    # parity = (i+j)%2; value = 1 - 2*parity. Position-based, no collective.
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=x.device)
    parity = (idx.view(N, 1) + idx.view(1, N)) % 2
    return (1 - 2 * parity).to(x.dtype)
